pages.text: The Nether is a major adventure destination and the home of the pack’s final boss. Bring blocks, food, suitable protection and a way to mark your route.

Explore Incendium’s different biomes rather than treating the dimension as a single mining area. Look for structures and follow its advancements for named encounters and discoveries. The Nether quests help organize those adventures.
Before entering a large structure, establish a safe point outside. Keep enough supplies to leave even if the expedition takes longer than expected.
